articles.title_en: Russian strike on apartment building in Kharkiv, Ukraine, injures 25 people, including nine children, regional governor says
articles.lead_en: A Russian strike overnight on September 28 destroyed a section of an apartment building in Kharkiv’s Saltivskyi district. Twenty-five people, including nine children, were injured, according to Kharkiv Governor Oleh Syniehubov.

articles.title_en: A humanitarian crisis is gripping Russian-occupied Oleshky as food deliveries stop and safe evacuation becomes nearly impossible
articles.lead_en: Oleshky (Alyoshki in Russian) is a city on the left bank of the Dnipro River, across from Kherson on the right bank. Only nine kilometers (about six miles) separate them in a straight line.
